verdict.rationale: Jan supports connecting to hosted cloud model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Groq, MiniMax) as an alternative to running large models locally, which addresses the core need of offloading large models away from local hardware. However, this is framed as generic 'cloud integration' via API keys to third-party providers, not a purpose-built 'hosted cloud tier' offload feature with seamless no-download experience tailored to power-users' large-model needs. Missing for 10: no evidence of a dedicated Jan-hosted cloud tier, no documentation on switching from local to cloud specifically due to hardware insufficiency, no independent hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
